summary: Nora reads X with two tools, x_read (a pasted post or account link, or a typed handle) and x_search (free text), replacing social_fetch.
details: x_read takes the link as pasted: a post link reads the post and its thread, an account link reads the profile or, when asked, its recent posts. Share junk after the link is never sent.
A handle can be typed with or without the @.
Pasting an Instagram link into the X tool gets a note pointing at instagram_read instead of a failed read.
limitations: A single X post is read from its link only; a bare post number is not accepted.
